searchQueries.title: CKAN search queries
searchQueries.description: What to search for on data.vic.gov.au. Defaults target the Valuer-General property-sales statistics.

fileUrls.title: Direct file URLs (CSV or Excel)
fileUrls.description: Direct links to CSV or XLSX/XLS files (e.g. a specific VG statistics spreadsheet). Downloaded and parsed as-is — the most reliable path for a specific published spreadsheet.

suburbFilter.title: Suburb filter
suburbFilter.description: Keep only rows mentioning these suburbs/localities (case-insensitive substring match across all columns). Empty = keep everything.

maxDatasets.title: Max datasets per query
maxDatasets.description: Maximum number of datasets to process per search query.

maxRecordsPerResource.title: Max rows per resource
maxRecordsPerResource.description: Maximum number of rows to extract from each resource (CSV/Excel/DataStore).
